embeds.title: 🔴 Ukraine Probes Teen Suspect in Cyber Theft Scheme Targeting U.S. Online Retailer
embeds.description:
Ukrainian authorities have identified an 18-year-old suspect from Odesa allegedly linked to an international cybercrime operation that compromised nearly 30,000 customer accounts of an unnamed U.S.-based online retailer in California between 2024 and 2025. According to investigators, the group used info-stealing malware to harvest login credentials and session data, later using at least 5,800 compromised accounts to make unauthorized purchases worth approximately $721,000, causing over $250,000 in losses. The suspect allegedly managed online infrastructure to process and sell stolen data through online platforms and Telegram channels, and used cryptocurrency services for transactions with accomplices.

**Incident date:** 2024-2025 • **Confidence:** claim
